chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Shocks Beidou Academy with the Indestructible Seal
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen enters the prestigious Beidou Academy in Heavenly Emperor City and faces four experts. He uses the Undying Sect's Indestructible Seal to defeat a sixth-heaven cultivator in one blow, stunning the crowd.
